limitations: Originality is to the best of our knowledge. The result improves the implementation complexity of the Gao--Shan q-ary three-length construction; it does not strengthen the 3/4 Kraft threshold, extend the theorem to four lengths, or prove an optimal running-time lower bound. Standard priority queues and Cartesian-product enumeration are not claimed as independently novel. The motivating preprint is recent, and related binary implementation ideas may exist in older literature. No independent validation is asserted.
provenance: Scientific sources, proof evidence, and verification evidence are listed in RESULT.md and REVIEW.md.
record_title: Output-sensitive implementation of the q-ary three-length fix-free construction
